Account & sync — screens as built

Real screenshots from the Android emulator (light theme, English), taken during the end-to-end run. The grey round gear at the top right of each shot is the development build's menu button, not part of the app.

1 · Getting there

The only way in is a card on the You tab, under the masthead. Tap it to open Account.

2 · Account, signed in

Devices, Add a device, About you, Leaving. The ⋯ on a device row opens Rename / Remove in place.

3 · New device: “I already have an account”

The notice appears only when the device already holds data.

4 · Signed-in device: “Add a device”

With the camera in the build it opens on the scanner (the room is the emulator's fake camera); without it, straight to the code field.

5 · Settings → Privacy
